feature.summary: Lets a person attach pictures and PDFs to chat. The catalog records which models read pictures and PDFs, how many pictures one request may carry, and which detail levels are accepted. Apps warn early; the server refuses a picture turn for a model that cannot read pictures instead of rerouting.

purpose.what_it_does: Checks every picture or PDF turn against the chosen model: picture ability, picture count, detail level and native PDF handling. Auto routing sends picture turns to vision models.
purpose.why_it_exists: Providers reject a request that carries media the model cannot read. Checking against the catalog gives a clear message before money or time is spent.
purpose.who_uses_it: Anyone attaching photos or PDFs on Web, Desktop, Mobile, CLI, Chrome and VS Code; API developers sending image_url parts.
problems_solved: A picture sent to a text-only model is refused with a clear message.
Too many pictures are caught before sending.
A PDF goes native only where the model and route accept it; otherwise it is turned into text.
A detail value the model does not accept is refused.
use_cases: A user photographs a receipt and asks a question on Mobile.
A user attaches a PDF on Web and the model reads it natively.
A CLI user attaches a screenshot and is told to switch to a vision model.
A developer sends image_url parts with detail low or high to the API.

established.statement: The registry records image input per model; the product shows it and refuses or reroutes image turns to models that cannot read images (S76.03).
The registry records how many images a model accepts in one request and requests are checked against it (S76.04).
The registry records which models support high-detail inspection and the product requests high detail where supported (S76.05).
The registry records native PDF input per model and PDFs go natively to models that accept them (S76.06).
Web and desktop, mobile and the CLI must not silently route Local content to cloud; a Local-to-BYOK move is an explicit fork.

acceptance_criteria: Send a picture to an explicitly chosen text-only model through the API: HTTP 400 with code model_no_vision.
Send more pictures than the limit: HTTP 400 with code too_many_images naming the limit.
Send detail 'original' to a model that does not list it: HTTP 400 with code image_detail_unsupported; detail 'auto' always passes.
On Web attach a picture with a text-only model selected: the warning panel appears and Send is blocked until Auto, a compatible model or removal.
With Auto and a picture attached, the answering model has image input.
Attach a PDF to a model that lists pdf input: the PDF is sent natively; to one that does not, its text is sent instead.
On Mobile attach more pictures than the model limit: send is refused with the 'can read up to N images' message.
inferred: Only API callers can ask for high detail today; apps use auto. [inferred from S76.05 status and the lack of any detail control in the apps read]
The brief's 'refuses or reroutes' means refuse for an explicit model and reroute under Auto. [inferred]

[proposed] Record per-model file and image size limits in the registry (S76.30).

steps.what_happens: The person attaches a file; the app checks type, size, plan limits and (Mobile, CLI) picture count; Web checks the vision flag.
The app sends the turn with image parts or documents to the chat completions endpoint.
Auto resolves a vision model for image turns (multimodal task).
The server refuses on missing vision, count or detail; otherwise it decides native PDF versus text.
The provider adapter maps image parts and detail to the provider format and the provider answers.

data.where_stored: Sent with the turn; stored attachment records and hydration are handled in chat-attachment-hydration.ts (storage tables not read)
data.retained_or_deleted: unknown; not established from the code read

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: Image and PDF ability comes from the catalog row; the route's harness sets default limits. Provider adapters translate parts. Own-key (BYOK) and Local paths in the CLI keep PDFs native only when the model flag allows (agent/chat.rs:763-766); in Managed privacy mode the CLI does not keep PDFs native (same lines).

access_and_usage.account: Cloud turns need sign-in. Local mobile turns with images need no account for the image check itself.
access_and_usage.permissions: Picture URLs are checked by an egress policy ('image_url blocked by egress policy', request-processor.ts:606-612).
access_and_usage.subscription: Attachment byte limits depend on the plan on Web (ChatComposerNew.tsx:949-951) and Mobile (attachmentValidation.ts:34-48). Free promotional models may accept images only or text only (model-compatibility.ts:62-85).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Picture count per request from model or route (media-input.ts:60-66). PDF pages from model or route (media-input.ts:80-100). Request size cap MAX_CHAT_COMPLETION_REQUEST_BYTES is 2,000,000 (packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/tool-call-limits.ts:8).
access_and_usage.flags: Free-trial capability gate applies when free trial is enabled (request-processor.ts:4366).
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: Needs the vision flag for pictures and pdf in inputModalities for native PDF.
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Harness documentMediaTypes lists the PDF media type per route; routes without it get text fallback (media-input.ts:80-100).
access_and_usage.local_mode: Web with a local model: attachments are refused and the person is offered 'Switch to a cloud model' or remove (ChatComposerNew.tsx:1589, 5333-5360). Mobile Local: files up to the device ceiling, no per-message count or byte limit (attachmentValidation.ts:34-40); local model rows show 'Vision' when the on-device model reads pictures (service.ts:147). CLI Local privacy mode: documents are settled locally; not uploaded (agent/chat.rs:3733-3745).

corrections.claim: Free promotional models may accept images only or text only (model-compatibility.ts:62-85)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The behaviour exists, but model-compatibility.ts:55-90 holds only type declarations. The promotional text is at model-compatibility.ts:128. The images-only / text-only copy is at ChatComposerNew.tsx:5434-5445, driven by promotionalAttachmentConflict (1549). Section 2 repeats the bad citation.

corrections.claim: CLI Local privacy mode: documents are settled locally; not uploaded (agent/chat.rs:3733-3745)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The cited lines handle a block that already has an asset_id. Managed mode leaves it alone. Other modes replace it with the text '[this file was uploaded to AGI Cloud and is not available in this mode]'. The no-upload rule is at about 3756: can_upload = upload && managed && managed_accepts(...). Managed mode uploads files to AGI Cloud via upload_chat_attachment.
corrections.correction: The CLI uploads documents to AGI Cloud only in Managed privacy mode (chat.rs:3756). In other modes the PDF stays native if the model supports it, or becomes text on the device. A file already uploaded is replaced by a notice outside Managed mode.

corrections.claim: HEIC photo on Mobile Cloud rejected (attachmentValidation.ts:150-160); Empty file on Mobile rejected (attachmentValidation.ts:124)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The behaviour is real but the lines are wrong. HEIC is at 112-116, applies when destination === 'cloud' and the MIME is not a chat image type. The empty-file check is at line 100 (fileSize === 0). Lines 120-126 are the supported-document check.
corrections.correction: Cite attachmentValidation.ts:112-116 for HEIC and :100 for an empty file.

corrections.claim: Auto classifies image attachments as multimodal, whose policy requires imageInput (classify.ts:163-166; routing-policies.json:611-618)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: classify.ts:163-166 returns multimodal for image/ or video/ attachments. The file is packages/ai/model-registry/catalog/routing-policies.json. Lines 611-618 show the end of screen_automation (it requires imageInput) and the opening of the vision policy. I did not read the vision policy's requirements past line 620.
corrections.correction: Give the full path and the vision policy block lines. Image and video attachments both classify as multimodal.

missing_facts: CLI Managed privacy mode uploads PDFs and other files to AGI Cloud (can_upload = upload && managed && managed_accepts, then upload_chat_attachment). Documents leave the device in that mode. The page only says native PDF is not kept. apps/cli/src/agent/chat.rs:3756-3775.

The server vision refusal is skipped for uncatalogued models (turnCarriesImagesTheModelCannotRead returns false when caps are undefined). The count check is skipped when the limit is null. The page's 'refuses a picture turn for a model that cannot read pictures' overstates this. request-processor.ts:2865-2870, 5128-5129.
The free-trial gate runs for free-region fallback and promotion turns as well as free-trial requests, and it applies before the general vision check. request-processor.ts:3680-3686, 4366-4400.
